The 2026 Negeri Sembilan state election will take place on 1 August 2026 to elect members of the 16th Negeri Sembilan State Legislative Assembly. The dissolution was announced by incumbent Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun on 4 June 2026, signed by the Yang di-Pertuan Negeri Sembilan, Tuanku Muhriz. All 36 seats in the Negeri Sembilan State Legislative Assembly will be contested. The election will determine whether the incumbent Pakatan Harapan government under Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun retains power, or whether opposition coalitions such as Barisan Nasional or Perikatan Nasional can secure a majority.
